integrity: Formulae independently derived from normalized Gaussian short-time Fourier transforms; finite checks supplement, but do not replace, analytical arguments. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact interference-matrix conditioning is for symmetric two-tone Gaussian signals and entire frequency profiles on three time lines; it is not a noise-normalized global Gabor phase retrieval stability theorem. Qualitative irrationally spaced three-line uniqueness was established in earlier literature. Mathematical priority is only best-knowledge.
title: Arithmetic conditioning of three-line Gaussian interference measurements
